mixed_integration.limits: Integration evidence only; full corpus, native execution, trust/MCP and identity/stage gates remain required.

retained_route_clarification: Earlier transaction-level reconstruction tests could succeed by legacy retry. Current retention gate checks direct no-retry raw candidate byte match, exact retained-name membership, and direct selected-route artifact/ELF/words. Raw activation is separately checked by strict positive cases.
